subject: DI03009011

body.en:
Definition

Industrial wiring is the coordinated power,control,protection and protective-conductor installation supplying industrial processes under their operating and environmental duties.

Explanation and application

  • Identify motor nameplates,output/input rating,duty,pf,efficiency,starting method,simultaneity and process interlocks;starting current is not the same as continuous demand.
  • Assess route,ambient temperature,grouping,vibration,dust,water,corrosion and hazardous-area classification;ordinary enclosures/starters are not automatically suitable for explosive atmospheres.
  • Plan isolation,short-circuit protection,overload protection,control supply,PE/bonding,maintenance access and documentation as one coordinated design.
Motor shaft kWdirect input?

No;Pin=Pout/η.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Industrial wiring industrial processને operating/environmental duty પ્રમાણે supply આપતું coordinated power,control,protection/PE installation છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Nameplate,output-input,duty,pf,efficiency,start method,simultaneity/interlocks લો.Start I continuous demand નથી.
  • Route,T,grouping,vibration,dust,water,corrosion/hazard classification લો.Ordinary enclosure explosive atmosphere માટે આપોઆપ યોગ્ય નથી.
  • Isolation,SC/overload protection,control supply,PE,access/documents coordinated designમાં લો.
Shaft kW એટલે Input?

નહિ.Pin=Pout/η છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Balanced three-phase motor with shaft output Pout,efficiency η,line voltage VL,power factor cosφ;use consistent W,Vor kW/kVunits.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Efficiency η=Pout/Pin,so Pin=Pout/η.
  2. Electrical input Pin=√3VLIcosφ;therefore Pout=η√3VLIcosφ.
  3. Solve I=Pout/(√3VLηcosφ).For a single-phase motor use I=Pout/(Vηcosφ),not √3.
  4. For7.5kW,400V,η0.9,pf0.8:I≈15.035A.This estimates running current;actual nameplate/start duty governs selection.

Interpretation and check

Do not divide shaft output only by √3VLpfand omit efficiency;motor starting and protective-device curves require separate checks.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Balanced motorમાં shaft Pout,η,VL/cosφ લો.W-V કે kW-kV units consistent રાખો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. η=Pout/Pinથી Pin=Pout/η છે.
  2. Pin=√3VLIcosφ હોવાથી Pout=η√3VLIcosφ છે.
  3. I=Pout/(√3VLηcosφ) છે.Single-phaseમાં I=Pout/(Vηcosφ) લો,√3 નહીં.
  4. 7.5kW,400V,η0.9/pf0.8માં I≈15.035A છે.આ running estimate છે.Actual nameplate-start dutyથી selection કરો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Outputને ફક્ત√3VLpfથી divide કરી η નછોડો.Starting/device curves અલગ ચકાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Protective coordination is the selection of conductors and protective devices so normal duty is carried and faults are interrupted within the applicable thermal/electrical limits.

Explanation and application

  • Use corrected ampacity,voltage drop,starting drop,fault withstand,disconnection and terminal/environment limits;check contactor utilisation duty and short-circuit coordination of the assembly.
  • An overload relay protects against specified motor overload conditions,not every short circuit;an isolator alone is not a fault-interrupting breaker.
  • Overload settings depend on nameplate,relay location and manufacturer method.A relay in a delta leg is not automatically set to the same current as a line relay.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Protective coordination એટલે normal duty વહન થાય અને faults applicable thermal-electrical limitsમાં clear થાય તેવી conductor-device selection.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Ampacity,V/start drop,fault withstand,disconnection/terminals-environment લો.Contactor duty/assembly SCcoordination ચકાસો.
  • Overload relay specified overload માટે છે;બધા SC માટે નથી.Isolator fault breaker નથી.
  • OLR setting nameplate,location/manufacturer પ્રમાણે છે.Delta-leg relayને line-relay જેટલું automatic set નકરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

For a declared conductor material/temperature coefficient k,area S,fault current Iand clearing time t;the adiabatic approximation is valid only within its applicable conditions.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Permitted conductor I²t withstand is represented by k²S²;require ∫i²dt≤k²S².
  2. For the assumed constant equivalent RMSfault current,∫i²dt≈I²t.
  3. Solve S≥I√t/k.For I1000A,t0.1s,k115A√s/mm²,S≥2.75mm²approximately;an assumed available4mm²candidate still needs every other design check.

Interpretation and check

k115is supplied case data,not universal for all metals/insulations;use the actual device let-through energy and applicable standard method.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Declared material-temperature k,area S,fault I/time t લો.Adiabatic approximation applicable conditionsમાં જ valid છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Conductor I²t withstand k²S²થી ∫i²dt≤k²S² જોઈએ.
  2. Assumed equivalent RMSIમાં ∫i²dt≈I²t છે.
  3. S≥I√t/k છે.I1000A,t0.1s/k115A√s/mm²માં S≥2.75mm² છે.Assumed4mm²candidateમાં other checks જોઈએ.

k115 supplied data છે,બધા materialsનું universal નથી.Actual let-through energy/standard method લો.

Given and assumptions

Use insulated wire outside diameter d,quantity n,conduit inside diameter Dand declared permitted fill fraction f;f0.4is assumed teaching data,not a universal rule.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Total occupied area Aw=Σnπd²/4;available conduit area Ac=πD²/4.
  2. Require Aw/Ac≤f,so D≥√(Σnd²/f).
  3. For6wires of3.5mmoutside diameter,f0.4:Dmin≈13.56mminside.Check an actual16mminside candidate:fill≈28.71%.
  4. Also check bends,pulling length,heat/grouping,spare capacity and the manufacturer ID;nominal20mmconduit does not necessarily have20mmID.

Interpretation and check

Do not substitute conductor mm²for insulated-wire diameter or confuse radius with diameter.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Insulated outside d,quantity n,conduit inside D/allowed f લો.f0.4 teaching assumption છે,universal rule નહીં.

  2. Aw/Ac≤fથી D≥√(Σnd²/f) મળે.

h.en: Industrial DB,main switch and starter selection
h.gu: Industrial DB,Main Switch તથા Starter Selection

body.en:
Definition

A motor starter is an arrangement that controls motor starting/stopping and includes or coordinates the required switching and protective functions for its duty.

Explanation and application

  • Classify DOL,star-delta,reversing,soft-starter and drive-based methods as applicable;choose from motor/line ratings,starting torque,current,process duty and manufacturer coordination.
  • DB/main switch selection uses demand,spare ways,poles,voltage,thermal duty,fault level,busbar/withstand ratings and lockable isolation;check motor starting rather than blindly applying a domestic breaker curve.
  • Control voltage and coil rating must match the control supply;nameplate contactor ampere number alone does not establish a motor duty or short-circuit rating.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motor starter motor start-stop control કરતું તથા duty પ્રમાણે switching/protection functions include-coordinate કરતું arrangement છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • DOL,star-delta,reversing,soft starter/drive methods classify કરો.Motor-line rating,torque,I,process/manufacturerથી પસંદ કરો.
  • DB-mainમાં demand,ways,poles,V,thermal,fault,busbar/withstand/isolation લો.Motor start માટે domestic curve blind નલો.
  • Control V/coil supply match કરો.ફક્ત contactor ampere numberથી motor duty/SCrating સાબિત નથી થતું.

body.en:
Definition

A direct-on-line starter connects a suitable motor to full rated line voltage through a controlled contactor and coordinated protection.

Classification / representative type

  • DOLis one starter type;the diagram is a simplified isolated24Vcontrol ladder,not a complete certified industrial safety circuit.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Main contactor Kswitches the motor power poles;short-circuit protection is a separately coordinated function.
  2. Overload relay senses motor duty and provides an NCtrip contact in the control chain.
  3. STOPNCand STARTNOoperators command the coil;the coil voltage matches the isolated control supply.
  4. Kauxiliary NOcontact provides hold-in around STARTonly;it must not bypass STOPor the overload contact.
  5. Enclosure,terminals,ferrules,labels and continuous PE/bonding provide identification and protective integrity.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. With STOPand overload contacts healthy,press STARTto complete the coil circuit.
  2. Kenergises,main contacts feed the motor and auxiliary NOcloses.
  3. Releasing STARTleaves the coil supplied through the auxiliary hold-in contact.
  4. Pressing STOPor an overload trip breaks the common control chain and releases K.
  5. Loss of control supply releases K;normal restoration does not intentionally bypass the need for a fresh STARTcommand.

Limitations and safety

Emergency-stop safety functions require the risk-assessed safety architecture;one ordinary NCbutton is not proof of a certified emergency-stop system.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

DOL starter controlled contactor/protectionથી suitable motorને full rated line V સાથે જોડે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • DOL એક type છે.Diagram simplified isolated24Vcontrol છે,complete certified safety circuit નથી.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Main K motor power poles switch કરે.SCprotection અલગ coordinated function છે.
  2. OLR duty sense કરીને controlમાં NCtrip contact આપે.
  3. STOPNC/STARTNO coil control કરે.Coil V isolated supply match કરે.
  4. KauxNO STARTની આસપાસ hold આપે.STOP-OLR bypass નથાય.
  5. Enclosure,terminals,ferrules,labels/PE integrity આપે.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. STOP-OLR healthy હોય ત્યારે STARTથી coil circuit complete થાય.
  2. K energise થઈ main motorને feed/auxNO close થાય.
  3. START છોડતાં auxholdથી coil supply ચાલુ રહે.
  4. STOP/overloadથી common chain તૂટે અને K release થાય.
  5. Supply lossથી K release થાય.Normal restoreમાં fresh STARTને bypass નકરો.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Emergency-stop માટે assessed safety architecture જોઈએ.Ordinary NCbuttonથી certified safety સાબિત નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A star-delta starter starts a compatible six-terminal motor in star and then runs it in delta at the rated line voltage.A reversing starter changes phase sequence using mutually interlocked switching.

Explanation and application

  • Star-delta uses main,star and delta contactors plus transition control;star and delta contactors require electrical and mechanical interlocking with break-before-make operation.
  • Example:a400/690VΔ/Ymotor is compatible with delta running on400V;do not assume a230/400VΔ/Ymotor can run in delta on400V.
  • Reversing interchanges two phases by approved contactors,not manual live swaps;simultaneous forward/reverse closing can cause a severe fault.
  • Identify power/control diagrams separately and verify each interlock on an approved isolated trainer before any authorised operation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Star-deltaમાં compatible six-terminal motor starમાં start/deltaમાં run થાય.Reversingમાં mutually interlocked switchingથી phase sequence બદલાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Main,star/delta contactors/transition control હોય.Star-delta વચ્ચે electrical-mechanical interlock/break-before-make જરૂરી છે.
  • 400/690VΔ/Ymotor400Vએ delta run માટે compatible છે.230/400VΔ/Ymotorને400Vએ delta run યોગ્ય નધારો.
  • Reversing approved contactorsથી two phases બદલે.Live swap નકરો.Simultaneous F-Rથી severe fault થાય.
  • Power-control diagrams અલગ ઓળખો.Approved isolated trainerમાં interlocks verify કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Same line voltage VL,same standstill phase impedance Zand compatible motor;ideal voltage-based comparison only.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Delta phase voltage VφΔ=VL;star phase voltage VφY=VL/√3.
  2. Therefore IφY=IφΔ/√3;line currents are ILY=IφYand ILΔ=√3IφΔ.
  3. Ratio ILY/ILΔ=1/3;with torque approximately proportional to phase-voltage squared,TY/TΔ≈1/3.

Interpretation and check

These are starting comparisons,not the motor running current ratio;reduced torque can make star starting unsuitable for a heavy starting load.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Same VL,standstill phase Z/compatible motor લો.Ideal voltage comparison છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Delta VφΔ=VL/star VφY=VL/√3 છે.
  2. તેથી IφY=IφΔ/√3 છે.Line ILY=IφY/ILΔ=√3IφΔ છે.
  3. ILY/ILΔ=1/3 અને T∝Vφ²થી TY/TΔ≈1/3 છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આ starting comparisons છે,running ratio નથી.Low starting torqueથી heavy load માટે method unsuitable થઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition

A reversing starter uses two mutually exclusive contactor paths to produce opposite motor phase sequences while maintaining coordinated stop,overload and protective functions.

Explanation and application

  • Forward coilis fed through the reverse contactor NCinterlock;reverse coilis fed through the forward NCinterlock.Each hold-in contact bypasses only its STARTbutton.
  • Both directions remain downstream of the common STOP/overload chain;mechanical interlocking and the rated switching sequence are also required.
  • The isolated24Vladder is a teaching diagram,not a complete power/safety design;actual reversal may require stop/delay and process safeguards.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reversing starter mutually exclusive contactor pathsથી opposite phase sequence બનાવે અને coordinated stop-overload/protection જાળવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Forward coilમાં reverse NC અને reverse coilમાં forward NC હોય.દરેક hold ફક્ત પોતાનું START bypass કરે.
  • બંને common STOP-OLR પછી છે.Mechanical interlock/rated sequence પણ જોઈએ.
  • Isolated24Vladder teaching diagram છે,complete power-safety design નહીં.Actual reversalમાં stop-delay/process safeguards જોઈએ શકે.

body.en:
Definition

Industrial verification confirms documented protective,control and installation functions against the approved design and applicable requirements;it cannot be inferred from a motor merely rotating.

Explanation and application

  • Identify all power/control/PV/UPS/generator sources,stored charge and mechanical energy.Apply authorised isolation,lockout,dead verification and permits before work.
  • Inspect PE/bonding,terminations,phase identity,insulation,protection settings,control interlocks and safe restart behaviour;energised functional tests are restricted to authorised qualified personnel.
  • Industrial reports additionally identify motor/starter/panel ratings,relay location/settings,instrument data,actual results,defects and retest/authorisation status;no fictional Passedentries.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Industrial verification approved design/requirements સામે protection,control/installation functions ચકાસે છે.ફક્ત motor ફર્યો એટલે verified નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • All power-control/PV-UPS-generator,stored/mechanical energy ઓળખી isolation,lockout,dead verify/permit લો.
  • PE,terminals,phase,insulation,settings/interlocks/restart ચકાસો.Live functional tests qualified authorised personnel જ કરે.
  • Reportમાં motor-starter-panel ratings,relay location-settings,instruments,actual results/defects/retest-status લો.Fictional Passed નલખો.
